text:
maria: Quick heads-up — link-scan just flagged ~120 slow/timeout links in the KB (most under /docs/runtime/). I'm planning to pick a small batch to patch today but ownership for the runtime-guide pages is fuzzy. Who can volunteer for ~10–15 quick edits? pinging for async help.

link-scan-bot: Scan complete 2025-06-18T09:12Z — 118 slow links, 43 timeouts. CSV export: https://internal/reports/linkscan/1765436789.csv. Top affected prefix: /docs/runtime/ (see CSV).

sam: I can take a batch. Quick question: do we want one combined PR or many small PRs for these tiny link fixes? :hand: 

maria: Small PRs please (easier to review / revert). Here's a quick query to pull the flagged list — use the first ~12 that look straightforward:

```bash
curl -s 'https://internal/api/link-scan?run=1765436789&status=slow' | jq -r '.[].path' | grep '/docs/runtime/' | head -n 20
```

sam: Perfect, thanks. I'll open PRs titled like: `kb: fix slow links (runtime) - 1/12` etc. Please add label `docs-fix` and request reviewers @kevin and @maria on each.

kevin: Friday review window works for me (UTC-8). If you tag me I'll try to batch-review. Quick reminder: when you rehost images, update alt text and run a local render check.

maria: +1 on the alt text note. Also if any flagged item is a 3rd-party embed, mention it in the PR body so legal/product can triage. Thanks all :sparkles:

devex: If you rehost assets, use the `static-cdn` prefix and run `yarn docs:build` locally to confirm staging renders. Also add a short line in the PR describing the rehost (old src -> new src).

sam: Will do. First PR up in ~2h, assigning to myself now. Thanks everyone!
